title: Probability Foundations
description: Combinatorics, counting principles, conditional probability, and Bayes' theorem.

title: Statistical Inference
description: Estimation, hypothesis testing, MLE, and confidence intervals.

title: Linear Algebra for Quant Finance
description: Eigenvalues, SVD, PCA, and covariance matrix applications.

title: Optimizing Risk and Return
description: Mean-variance optimization, efficient frontier, and constrained portfolio optimization.

title: Constrained Optimization
description: Lagrange multipliers, KKT conditions, and quadratic programming for portfolio problems.

title: Overview: Markets and Instruments
description: Introduction to fixed income, equities, currencies, commodities, and derivatives.

title: Treasury Debt
description: Bond pricing fundamentals, treasury quotes, bills vs notes vs bonds.

title: Yield Curve and Discount Rates
description: Term structure, yield curve construction, discount factors, and forward rates.

title: Interest Rate Risk
description: Duration, convexity, DV01, and hedging interest rate exposure.

title: Equity Options
description: Option payoffs, put-call parity, intrinsic vs time value, and basic strategies.

title: Binomial Trees
description: One-period and multi-period binomial models for option pricing.

title: Black-Scholes and the Greeks
description: Black-Scholes formula derivation, delta, gamma, vega, theta, and hedging.

title: Black's Formulas
description: Black's model for caps, floors, swaptions, and interest rate options.

title: Volatility Modeling
description: Implied vs realized vol, volatility surface, local vol, and stochastic vol.

title: Volatility Skew Fitting
description: Practical techniques for fitting volatility skews to market data.

title: Measuring Risk
description: Risk metrics, volatility, drawdown, and tail risk measurement.

title: Value-at-Risk
description: Parametric, historical, and Monte Carlo VaR. Expected Shortfall.

title: Market Microstructure Lab
description: Order books, CLOB mechanics, order flow analysis, and iceberg orders.

title: The Art of Risk Taking
description: Frameworks for thinking about risk, position sizing, and decision making under uncertainty.

title: Market Impact
description: Almgren-Chriss model, optimal execution, and price impact estimation.
